# Total return swap on a bond (`trs-bond` v1)

Pays the bond's total return against funding.

**Asset class:** Credit · **Family:** swap · **Product type:** `TRS_BOND`

Applies to trades whose `productType` is `TRS_BOND`. Open one with `TRD <tradeId>`.

```sutra
sutra: trs-bond
version: 1
description: "Pays the bond's total return against funding."
match: { kind: trade, where: "$.productType == 'TRS_BOND'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Credit · Total return swap on a bond, id: $.tradeId, with: "link($.counterparty.id, 'counterparty', $.counterparty.name)" }
strip:
  - { label: Notional, bind: "$.currency + ' ' + fmt($.notional, 'amount0')" }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Trade date, bind: $.tradeDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturityDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: MTM (USD), bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: CS01 (USD), bind: $.risk.cs01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: DV01 (USD), bind: $.risk.dv01, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    code: TRM
    key: F2
    columns:
      - { label: Funding spread, bind: $.terms.fundingSpread, fmt: bp1 }
      - { label: Reset, bind: $.terms.resetFrequency }
      - { label: Effective, bind: $.effectiveDate, fmt: date }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterparty.name }
  - id: legs
    kind: tabs
    title: Legs
    each: $.legs
    layout: columns
    tabTitle: "'Leg ' + @.leg + ' · ' + @.label"
    body:
      kind: kv
      columns:
        - { label: Pay/receive, bind: "@.payReceive" }
        - { label: Rate type, bind: "@.rateType" }
        - { label: Index, bind: "@.index" }
        - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
        - { label: Spread, bind: "@.spread", fmt: bp1 }
        - { label: Frequency, bind: "@.frequency" }
        - { label: Day count, bind: "@.dayCount" }
        - { label: Currency, bind: "@.currency" }
        - { label: Notional, bind: "@.notional", fmt: amount0 }
  - id: schedule
    kind: ladder
    title: Cashflows
    code: CF
    key: F3
    rows: $.schedule
    highlight: "#index == $.nextIndex"
    columns:
      - { label: Pay date, bind: "@.payDate", fmt: date }
      - { label: Leg, bind: "@.leg" }
      - { label: Type, bind: "@.type" }
      - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
      - { label: PV, bind: "@.pv", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - id: marketData
    kind: line
    title: "Bond (security master): Price, last 30 days"
    code: BND
    key: F4
    area: right
    source: "link($.underlyingBond, 'bond')"
    rows: history
    x: date
    y: price
    fmt: price2
  - id: sensitivities
    kind: hbar
    title: CS01 by bucket (USD)
    code: SENS
    area: right
    rows: $.sensitivities
    label: bucket
    value: cs01
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: Daily P&L, last 20 days (USD)
    code: PNL
    area: right
    rows: $.pnlHistory
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Terms

Product-specific terms live under `terms` in the trade document.

| Field | Label | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `terms.fundingSpread` | Funding spread | `bp1` |
| `terms.resetFrequency` | Reset | text |

## Market data

Reference fields on the trade point at the market data it is valued with. They show under *Linked entities* and drive F8 impact ("which trades use this curve?").

| Field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `underlyingBond` | `bond` (Bond (security master)) | `{bond}` |
| `discountCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `ois:{ccy}` |
| `repoCurve` | `repo-curve` (Repo curve) | `{ccy}` |

## Risk

| Measure | Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| CS01 | `risk.cs01` | value change for a 1 bp widening of credit spreads |
| DV01 | `risk.dv01` | value change for a 1 bp parallel fall in rates |

The *CS01 by bucket* chart reads `sensitivities[].cs01`.

## Legs

2 legs under `legs`, shown side by side: pay/receive, rate type, index, rate, spread, frequency, day count, currency, notional.

## Cashflows

`schedule` rows (ladder), F3: `payDate`, `leg`, `type`, `rate`, `amount`, `pv`. The next event is highlighted (`nextIndex`).

## Layout notes

- The strip leads with size and dates, then MTM (emphasised) and the product's main risk measures.
- F2 is the terms, F3 the schedule, F4 the market data it is most sensitive to; F7 opens the netting set, F8 shows impact and F9 the raw document.
- Common fields (counterparty, netting set, book, trader, MTM, P&L) are described in the pack guide.
